parts.say: Hi! In this video we find the tangent to a parabola, one step at a time.
This is the parabola f of x equals x squared.
The tangent at x equals one has slope two, because f prime of one is two.
At the point P, the parabola and the tangent touch.

parts.say: From P we go exactly one to the right.
Up to the tangent, that is two units.
So the slope is two over one, which is two. That matches f prime of one.
The slope of the tangent is the derivative at x nought.
The point of contact lies on the curve.
So t of x equals m times x minus x nought, plus f of x nought. Good luck!
